channel.title: Scottish Daily Express - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Scottish Daily Express (scottishdailyexpress.co.uk)

item.title: Lucky for some! MSPs get brand new perks to go alongside £3,000 pay rise
item.description: Holyrood parliamentarians will not only net an above inflation pay rise from April - but will also be allowed to claim for a free printer and have council tax on their second homes paid for by the taxpayer.

item.title: Revealed: Total number of foreign child groomers and traffickers in Scots jails
item.description: Exclusive: Around 8% of criminals held by the Scottish Prison Service are foreign nationals, with a significant number locked up for human trafficking or child grooming offences

item.title: SNP Government accused of being in 'denial over 'stripping' of fire service
item.description: Critics raised concerns over the firefighters ability to tackle future fires following significant cuts made to the force over the course of the SNP's time in power.

item.title: SNP plot parking space cuts, speed limits reductions and city centre charges
item.description: The Scottish Government published its climate change plan which included even more punishments for motorists to get them to stop driving their vehicles.

item.title: Bad news for the Nats... Scexit-supporting George Galloway is YOUR problem now!
item.description: The firebrand politician was a staunch campaigner for the Union in the 2014 independence referendum but he's changed his mind as he bids to get elected to Holyrood in Nicola Sturgeon's old Glasgow Southside seat

item.title: Nicola Sturgeon claims Operation Branchform made her 'stronger'
item.description: The former First Minister opened up about the long-running investigation into the SNP's finances, which saw her estranged husband Peter Murrell charged with embezzlement

item.title: Alan Carr explains why he bought a £3.25m Scottish castle for his Disney+ show
item.description: The Celebrity Traitors winner has big plans for Ayton Castle in the Borders, with the trials and tribulations of his new life to be recorded for a reality TV show called 'Castle Man'

item.title: A pragmatic middle path for North Sea oil and gas needed for Scotland to survive
item.description: EXPRESS LETTERS, TUESDAY, MARCH 24, 2026: The thorny issue of energy – both at home and in the wider world – is still uppermost in the minds of many readers

item.title: SNP Government loaned £286m to Sanjeev Gupta without 'adequate' background check
item.description: Nicola Sturgeon and John Swinney were wined and dined by Sanjeev Gupta as he persuaded them to hand over millions to help him buy steel plants and a smelter in Scotland.

item.title: Top Nat Linden weeps in court during sex pest trial as he admits being 'naive'
item.description: The former leader of North Lanarkshire Council, who faces 15 charges including sexual assault, struggled to maintain his composure on the fifth day of his trial at Falkirk Sheriff Court
